Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production fighting-game animation sprite atlas, PHOTOGRAPHIC HUMAN CUTOUTS. Keep exactly the real person in the reference photos: same face, slim build, short dark hair, black short-sleeved T-shirt with small round chest badge, charcoal trousers, dark trainers with white soles. References are original non-AI photos. Retain their photographic realism and identity, NOT illustration or pixel art. Movement choreography should read like a Street Fighter 2D fighter: clean side-on readable silhouettes, strong planted stance, weight transfer, snappy extension, deliberate recovery. Camera locked, looking right, consistent body size, lighting and identity in every cell. Background truly transparent alpha, no floor, cast shadows, scenery, lettering, frame numbers, grid lines or effects. OUTPUT EXACTLY 40 separate full-body poses in a rigid 8-column by 5-row grid, row-major chronological order. Landscape canvas aspect 8:5, ideally 2048x1280, forty equal 256x256 cells. Each entire character must stay inside its own cell with wide transparent margins, never overlap adjacent cells. Standing figure height at most 165px per cell, soles baseline at 215px, torso centered around x=102px to leave attack space to right; crouching figure stays proportionally shorter, airborne figure uses consistent body scale. Continuous anatomically coherent motion, each of the 40 frames a subtly DIFFERENT pose, no repeated held poses. Frames 1-8 anticipation/guard windup, 9-16 accelerating attack, 17-24 fully articulated strike with small motion through impact, 25-32 recoil, 33-40 settle back to ready. Same head, limbs, clothing, proportions and support-foot anchoring throughout. Each cell contains one person only, two arms two legs, no extra fingers/limbs or ghosting. Avoid stretching a single photo, opacity crossfades, motion blur, painted effects or fake transparency.
CRITICAL: Forty complete figures INCLUDING THE ENTIRE LAST ROW AND ALL SHOES. Leave at least 15% blank transparent vertical spacing at top AND bottom of EACH cell. Do not enlarge figures to fill cells. Do not crop at canvas edges. ALL FIVE ROWS must have the exact same row pitch, ALL EIGHT COLUMNS the same pitch. Smaller figures with safe margins are better than large cropped figures.
ATTACK lp: Standing light lead-hand jab to face. Short straight extension, rear hand guards chin, both feet planted. One jab across40frames, start/end guard.
